summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments by triaging, fixing, and replying to each unresolved thread on the current branch.
summary.outcome: Two unresolved review threads were identified and fixed: input validation added to the load-test workflow and verification errors wrapped in metrics.measure in the file workload. Changes were committed and pushed.

repo: Load test workflow at .github/workflows/load-test.yml exports client_count without input validation.
File workload at tests/load/src/workloads/file-workload.ts had verification errors thrown outside metrics.measure, causing them to be excluded from error metrics.

code.finding: client_count workflow input lacked validation; added validation to prevent invalid values from propagating.
Verification errors must be thrown inside metrics.measure blocks to be captured in error metrics; errors thrown outside are invisible to the metrics system.

workflow: Use gh api graphql with reviewThreads query to fetch and filter unresolved PR threads.
Reply to threads via REST (gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments with --field in_reply_to as integer) and resolve via GraphQL mutation separately.
Run pnpm typecheck before committing to catch type errors introduced by fixes.

open_items: E2E tests were not run; transcript notes they should be run for E2E-relevant changes but skipped here.
